probe_design: Synthetic prompts and manually specified candidate expectations; measured model outcomes are not synthetic.
timing_limit: Whole discovery-batch timings include actual direction-fitting and cache state; no controlled speed comparison.
projection_scope: Exact search result with repository identity metadata omitted. No outer receipt paths, timestamps, logs or organization data.

points.reason: Measure the zero or smallest intervention control
